system_description.narrative_title: Israel's war, regional spillover, and political fallout
system_description.narrative_summary: A concentrated military campaign around Gaza is producing high civilian casualties and cross-border strikes into southern Lebanon while generating regional condemnations and diplomatic friction. The situation operates as an open system: kinetic, political, legal, humanitarian and informational flows exchange feedback with neighboring states, non-state armed groups, diasporas and foreign domestic politics, producing escalation risks and domestic polarization. Domestic events (civil-military tensions, indictments, social hate incidents) and international reactions are mutually reinforcing, creating contagion across borders and political arenas.
system_description.scope: Military operations involving Israel, Gaza (Hamas) and southern Lebanon; Israeli civil-military relations and political leadership decisions; civilian populations, humanitarian impact and mass casualties; regional diplomatic responses and legal/justice actions affecting individuals and firms; diaspora and Western domestic political reactions.
system_description.super_system: Regional security architecture and international order in the Middle East (including great-power diplomacy and Western domestic politics that mediate responses).
adjacent_subsystems: Israeli domestic politics and civil-military relations
Gaza/Hamas governance and Palestinian civilian population and humanitarian system
Western domestic politics and diaspora influence (US, Canada, Europe)

variables.name: Military kinetic intensity
variables.description: The aggregate tempo and scale of armed operations and direct combat actions in the conflict zone per unit time.

variables.name: Cross-border hostilities
variables.description: The frequency and intensity of attacks, strikes and armed incidents that cross international or de facto borders.

variables.name: Civilian casualty rate
variables.description: The rate at which non-combatants are killed or injured in the conflict per unit time.

variables.name: Displaced population (stock)
variables.description: The total number of people uprooted, internally displaced or seeking refuge as a result of hostilities at a given time.

variables.name: Humanitarian access level
variables.description: The degree to which aid actors can reach affected populations, measured by permissions, corridors, and security enabling deliveries.

variables.name: Civil–military tension
variables.description: The intensity of institutional friction and disagreement between civilian political leadership and military leadership.

variables.name: Political polarization
variables.description: The extent of ideological and partisan division within domestic political discourse and public debate.

variables.name: Diaspora mobilization
variables.description: The level of organized political, protest, financial and lobbying activity by diaspora communities abroad.

variables.name: Legal accountability rate
variables.description: The pace at which legal actions (investigations, indictments, prosecutions) related to the conflict are initiated or advanced.

variables.name: Hate incident frequency
variables.description: The rate of reported hate crimes, harassment and sectarian-targeted incidents in affected societies.

variables.name: Diplomatic pressure intensity
variables.description: The aggregate level of diplomatic actions, condemnations, leverage and formal pressures applied by external actors.

variables.name: Great‑power engagement
variables.description: The extent and depth of involvement by major external powers in diplomacy, military posture, or mediation related to the crisis.

variables.name: Information and propaganda volume
variables.description: The volume and velocity of news, social media messaging, propaganda and misinformation circulating about the conflict.

variables.name: Business exposure level
variables.description: The degree to which commercial actors and economic activity are exposed to operational, legal, and reputational risks from the crisis.

variables.name: Border security tightness
variables.description: The level of controls, closures and security measures at borders and checkpoints affecting movement of people and goods.

variables.name: Humanitarian aid flow
variables.description: The rate at which humanitarian supplies, funding and personnel are mobilized and delivered to affected populations.

catalysts.title: Escalation in southern Lebanon exchanges
catalysts.description: Renewed strikes and evacuation warnings in southern Lebanon trigger more cross-border exchanges and strikes between Israel and Lebanon-based forces.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Israeli military issues evacuation warning to village in southern Lebanon'; 'Israel strikes south Lebanon after soldiers killed...'

catalysts.title: Domestic civil–military row in Israel
catalysts.description: Sacking of a general on live TV and ensuing political rows drive sustained institutional friction between civilian and military leadership.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Israel’s defence minister triggers row after sacking general on TV' and related political coverage.

catalysts.title: Rise in sectarian and hate incidents
catalysts.description: Reported spitting and other attacks indicate an uptick in hate incidents inside Israel and among communities abroad, likely sustaining short‑term increases in targeted attacks.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Spitting Attacks Show Rise of Anti-Christian Hate in Israel' plus related charged incidents.

catalysts.title: Worsening humanitarian access in Gaza
catalysts.description: High civilian death tolls and active strikes are likely to further restrict aid corridors and impede deliveries into Gaza in the near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Gazans bury nearly a whole clan...'; 'Regional states condemn Israeli strikes in Gaza; Israel blames Hamas'.

catalysts.title: Surge in regional diplomatic pressure
catalysts.description: Condemnations from neighboring states and regional diplomacy will increase formal pressure on Israel and raise external involvement.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Regional states condemn Israeli strikes in Gaza; Israel blames Hamas' and related strikes in Lebanon.

catalysts.title: Diaspora protests and corporate pressure
catalysts.description: Political divisions abroad and legal/corporate cases tied to the war will drive mobilization, protests, and reputational pressure on firms with Israel links.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'The Democrats’ civil war over Israel is getting worse'; 'Teva seeks to keep Israel ties from jury, cites Gaza war'.

catalysts.title: Increase in legal actions and indictments
catalysts.description: Rare indictments and charges related to killings and alleged terrorism signal a potential uptick in prosecutions and legal scrutiny connected to the conflict.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Israel charges settler in Palestinian activist's killing...'; 'Canadian military says soldier charged with terrorism offenses...'
